_comment: Copy to keywords.json (gitignored, chmod 600) or fill it in from the Cities/Niche tab, which writes this file for you. Read-only API access: it spends API units from your subscription, never money.

_notes.batch: Keywords per request, capped by your Ahrefs plan: Lite 100, Standard 250, Advanced 500, Enterprise unlimited. Too high and the whole batch is refused.
_notes.units: Keywords Explorer costs 50 units minimum per request plus one unit per row per field; volume, difficulty and cpc are all cheap fields. The Test button reads your unit balance through an endpoint that consumes none.
_notes.cpc: Ahrefs returns CPC in US cents. The client divides by 100 before storing, so a $12.00 click is stored as 12.00, not 1200.
